# Nutricore Health

> Practical, evidence-informed health coaching for women 35+. Working across five pillars: sleep, resilience, nutrition, movement, and joy. No fads. A plan that fits real life.

Nutricore Health is a UK-based women's health coaching business founded by Marie Frost — registered naturopathic health coach, nutritional therapist, and lecturer in nutrition for health coaches at the College of Naturopathic Medicine. Marie is also Head of Health Coach at the Association of Naturopathic Practitioners (ANP) and runs the ANP Business Club.

The business operates three services: 1:1 health coaching delivered by qualified associate coaches under Marie's clinical oversight, corporate wellbeing programmes for employers, and digital products via Thinkific.

## What Nutricore Health Is

Nutricore Health supports women in midlife who feel stuck, low on energy, or unsure where to focus. The approach is whole-picture — working across five interconnected health pillars to help clients understand why they feel the way they do and build sustainable habits that fit their real life.

This is not a perimenopause-only brand. The five-pillar model applies across all women 35+ — whether navigating perimenopause, managing stress and burnout, improving sleep, or simply wanting to feel better.

The brand philosophy: boring basics, done properly. Evidence-led, not trend-led. No wellness jargon, no fear-based messaging, no supplement industry claims.

## Five Health Pillars

Every coaching programme works across all five areas. In women's health, everything is connected.

- **Sleep** — quality, duration, circadian rhythm. Poor sleep drives everything else.
- **Resilience** — nervous system, cortisol, capacity to recover. Builds the ability to handle pressure without burning out.
- **Nutrition** — practical, non-restrictive food strategy that works for hormones, gut health, and real life.
- **Movement** — sustainable, enjoyable physical activity appropriate for women 35+. Not what worked at 25.
- **Joy** — quality of life and what actually matters. The most overlooked pillar, and a deliberate part of every plan.

## Services

### 1:1 Health Coaching
A structured 12-week programme delivered by a qualified Nutricore health coach. Includes fortnightly 30-minute sessions, a full health intake and baseline review, weekly email check-ins, and a 30-minute final review. Marie provides clinical oversight on all associate-delivered programmes.

- Associate-delivered programme: £585
- Marie Frost direct: £785
- Continuation packages and ad hoc sessions available after programme completion

### Corporate Wellbeing
Women's health coaching as an employee benefit. Delivered in-person at employer sites by Marie Frost. Currently active with Ford Motors. Tailored to the organisation.

- Initial 45-minute 1:1 consultation: £75
- 30-minute follow-up: £45
- Group sessions: available, pricing on enquiry

### Digital Products
Self-paced courses and downloads hosted on Thinkific. Built around the five pillars. Practical and expert-led.

## Who We Work With

Women aged 35 and over who feel stuck with their health, have tried multiple approaches without lasting results, and want a practical plan built around their actual life — not another generic programme or fad diet.

Corporate clients: HR directors, L&D leads, and people directors at UK employers investing in female employee wellbeing.

## Founder

**Marie Frost** — Registered naturopathic health coach and nutritional therapist. Founder and clinical lead of Nutricore Health. Lecturer in nutrition for health coaches at the College of Naturopathic Medicine. Head of Health Coach at the Association of Naturopathic Practitioners (ANP). Runs the ANP Business Club for members.
